# Headway

> Headway Ag LLC builds solar ear tags that hold a virtual fence for livestock, and one ranch app for grazing, the herd, money and tax. The app has no subscription. Tags are in testing. Patent pending. Contact: hughheadwayag@gmail.com

## Key facts

- Product: Solar ear tags that hold a virtual fence, and one app for the whole place
- Livestock: All livestock
- Worn as: An ear tag, not a collar
- Power: Charged by the sun. Built to last 15 years
- Fence: Sound first. A mild stimulus only as a last step
- Also does: Moves, splits and guides the herd. Lightning and problem alerts. Weight records with a walk-over scale
- App: Map, grazing, herd records, money and tax. No subscription
- Status: Tags in testing. Patent pending
- Contact: hughheadwayag@gmail.com

## Home

- [Headway: virtual fencing ear tags and a ranch app](https://headwayfence.com/): Draw the fence on a map and solar ear tags hold it. One app runs the grazing, the herd, the money and the tax for all livestock.

## Virtual fencing

- [How virtual fencing for livestock works | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/): Draw a fence on a map and send it to solar ear tags. Animals hear a tone at the line and turn back. Strips, keep-out zones and moves, explained.
- [Strip grazing with a virtual fence | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/breaks.html): Give the herd fresh grass every day or two with no temporary fence. Ready-made strips, days of grass per strip, and moves in one tap from the app.
- [Keep-out zones: creeks, yards and pivots | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/keep-out-zones.html): Keep livestock off creek banks, the yard, pivot towers and bogs with keep-out zones drawn on a map. No posts, no wire, as many zones as you need.
- [Guide, split and move the herd from an app | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/herding.html): The virtual fence can move. Walk a mob to new ground, split calves or steers into their own group, and move the herd on a schedule from the app.
- [Virtual fencing and animal welfare | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/welfare.html): Headway tags use sound first and a mild stimulus only as a last step, with strict limits. Animals walking back or running are always left alone.
- [How to choose a virtual fence for livestock | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/choosing.html): Questions to ask any virtual fencing company before you buy: yearly cost, cloudy days, no signal, keep-out zones and welfare, with Headway's answers.

## The ear tag

- [Solar livestock ear tag for virtual fencing | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/): A solar ear tag that holds a virtual fence and shows where every animal is, how it is doing, and when one needs you. No collar to snap or catch.
- [Automatic livestock weight records | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/weighing.html): The tag does not weigh. It works with a walk-over scale, so every weight saves to the right animal with no typing, on the days you pick.
- [Tap a tag: livestock records in the field | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/tap-a-tag.html): Hold your phone to a Headway ear tag and that animal's record opens in the field, even with no signal. Handy for the vet in the pen.
- [Lightning alerts for livestock | Headway ear tags](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/lightning.html): Headway warns you when lightning is close to the herd, and one tap moves the animals off high ground or away from a lone tree to safer ground.
- [Solar powered livestock ear tag | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/solar.html): Headway ear tags are charged by the sun, with no batteries to change and no charging station. Sealed against rain, mud and dust, and built to last 15 years.
- [Virtual fencing with no cell signal | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/coverage.html): Ranches have dead spots. Headway tags keep the fence and the grazing plan on their own, and the app tells you if a tag has not checked in for a day.

## The app

- [Ranch app with a live map and no subscription | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/): One ranch app with no subscription: a live map of every animal, virtual fence strips, grazing plans, herd records, money and farm tax in one place.
- [Auto grazing and a season grazing planner | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/grazing.html): Plan which mob grazes where and when. The herd moves on time by itself, and you see the plan next to where the animals really grazed.
- [Livestock health, breeding and lifetime records | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/records.html): Every animal's story in one place, from birth to sale: family lines, vaccines and treatments with withdrawal dates, weights and every paddock.
- [Ranch cash flow and money planning | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/money.html): Plan the year and see where the money really goes. Add an expense in 3 taps, spot anything over budget, and have every entry ready for tax time.
- [Farm tax forms filled in for 12 countries | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/tax.html): The Headway app fills in your farm tax form as you go, for 12 countries, plus a simple income and expense report for anywhere else.
- [No subscription for the Headway ranch app](https://headwayfence.com/software/license.html): The Headway ranch app has no subscription. Headway Ag LLC owns it and licenses it to you, and your farm data stays yours to export any time.
